**Approach:** Introduce the pinned `go_router` with one top-level `redirect` keyed off `SessionStatus` (AD-8), leaving the documented seam for RF03's `VaultStatus` (AD-14). Build the side-menu `Drawer` (the sole navigation hub) and five polished placeholder screens. Also lock portrait orientation (deferred from Story 1.1 — this is the first story with real app-shell UI).

## Boundaries & Constraints

- Exactly one `GoRouter`/`redirect`; it composes only `SessionStatus` for now — leave an explicit code-comment seam where RF03 plugs `VaultStatus` in first (AD-14), never a second competing `redirect`.
- Routes: `/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth` (Story 1.5's target), `/` (Home/Chat + drawer), `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`, `/configuracoes`. The three non-Home destinations' back-arrow always targets `/` (matches prototype's `goHome` on all three) — no drawer-within-drawer.
- Story 1.5's overlay boundaries are unchanged: expiry never navigates away, screen state is preserved, one-shot-per-episode, "Entrar novamente" still ends at the same throwaway placeholder (now at `/reauth`).
- New `SessionRepository.markAuthenticated()` is called by `AuthCubit.submit()`'s success branch *before* emitting success, so the router's redirect already sees `authenticated` by the time `onAuthenticated` navigates to `/` — without this, a fresh login would redirect straight back to `/auth` on the very first post-login navigation.
- Drawer header uses a generic (non-personalized) `Avatar` + static label — deferred-work.md records why real identity isn't wired up yet.
- Planos de Ação renders the prototype's static 3-column kanban with its exact hardcoded example cards — zero backend calls, zero drag/drop (AGENTS.md: extension features stay non-functional).
- Every new color/size literal goes in `design_tokens.dart` (RNF08): heavier drawer scrim `rgba(36,31,25,.4)`, drawer width, kanban spacing/sizing.
- Native Flutter `Drawer`/`Scaffold.drawer` for the side menu (not a hand-rolled overlay like `ConfirmationDialog`) — single low-stakes use, avoids a second bespoke overlay mechanism.
- Lock portrait-only orientation in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` (deferred-work.md, from Story 1.1) — no landscape path anywhere (epic UX constraint).

**Never:**

- No vault/biometric logic added to the redirect (RF03/Epic 2's job) — leave the seam, don't hardcode a session-only assumption.
- No persisted/real user identity in the drawer (deferred-work.md), no editable profile name/avatar-upload (Epic 8).

# Sync Sprint Status

Shared sub-step for updating `sprint-status.yaml` during build. Called from any route (plan-code-review, one-shot, future routes) with a `target_status` parameter.

## Preconditions

Skip this entire file (return to caller) if ANY of:
- `story_key` is unset
- `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` does not exist on disk

## Instructions

1. Load the FULL `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` file.
2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.
3. **Idempotency check.** If `development_status[{story_key}]` is already at `target_status` or a later state (`review` is later than `in-progress`; `done` is later than both), return to caller — no write needed. Never regress a story's status.
4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). If that entry exists and is `backlog`, set it to `in-progress`. Leave it alone otherwise. Skip this sub-step entirely when `target_status` is not `in-progress`.
6. Refresh `last_updated` to the current date.
7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Today `main.dart` hardcodes a single `MaterialApp(home: StreamBuilder(...))` with three throwaway screens — no real navigation exists, and none of the four base destinations (Home/Chat, side menu, Meus Registros, Configurações) or the extension-feature entry (Planos de Ação) do either.

**Approach:** Introduce the pinned `go_router` with one top-level `redirect` keyed off `SessionStatus` (AD-8), leaving the documented seam for RF03's `VaultStatus` (AD-14). Build the side-menu `Drawer` (the sole navigation hub) and five polished placeholder screens. Also lock portrait orientation (deferred from Story 1.1 — this is the first story with real app-shell UI).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exactly one `GoRouter`/`redirect`; it composes only `SessionStatus` for now — leave an explicit code-comment seam where RF03 plugs `VaultStatus` in first (AD-14), never a second competing `redirect`.
- Routes: `/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth` (Story 1.5's target), `/` (Home/Chat + drawer), `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`, `/configuracoes`. The three non-Home destinations' back-arrow always targets `/` (matches prototype's `goHome` on all three) — no drawer-within-drawer.
- Story 1.5's overlay boundaries are unchanged: expiry never navigates away, screen state is preserved, one-shot-per-episode, "Entrar novamente" still ends at the same throwaway placeholder (now at `/reauth`).
- New `SessionRepository.markAuthenticated()` is called by `AuthCubit.submit()`'s success branch *before* emitting success, so the router's redirect already sees `authenticated` by the time `onAuthenticated` navigates to `/` — without this, a fresh login would redirect straight back to `/auth` on the very first post-login navigation.
- Drawer header uses a generic (non-personalized) `Avatar` + static label — deferred-work.md records why real identity isn't wired up yet.
- Planos de Ação renders the prototype's static 3-column kanban with its exact hardcoded example cards — zero backend calls, zero drag/drop (AGENTS.md: extension features stay non-functional).
- Every new color/size literal goes in `design_tokens.dart` (RNF08): heavier drawer scrim `rgba(36,31,25,.4)`, drawer width, kanban spacing/sizing.
- Native Flutter `Drawer`/`Scaffold.drawer` for the side menu (not a hand-rolled overlay like `ConfirmationDialog`) — single low-stakes use, avoids a second bespoke overlay mechanism.
- Lock portrait-only orientation in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` (deferred-work.md, from Story 1.1) — no landscape path anywhere (epic UX constraint).

**Ask First:** if hitting correct synchronous `redirect` re-evaluation on each `statusStream` emission seems to need any package beyond the already-pinned `go_router` (e.g. a different state-management dependency), stop and ask before adding one.

**Never:**
- No `CONVERSAS`/past-chat-session list in the drawer and no real chat (RF04/RF07 not built) — only the static "Novo Chat" action (closes the drawer, no-op) and the three nav items.
- No vault/biometric logic added to the redirect (RF03/Epic 2's job) — leave the seam, don't hardcode a session-only assumption.
- No persisted/real user identity in the drawer (deferred-work.md), no editable profile name/avatar-upload (Epic 8).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Boot, status not yet known | app launch | `/boot` splash (unchanged >300ms-threshold spinner) | N/A |
| Boot, unauthenticated | no/dead stored session | redirected to `/auth` | silent |
| Boot, authenticated/expired | valid stored session | redirected to `/` | silent |
| Fresh login/signup success | `AuthCubit.submit()` resolves `right` | `markAuthenticated()` emits `authenticated`, then `/` | N/A |
| Mid-session expiry, any of the 5 routes | `AUTH_EXPIRED` | overlay over current route, route unchanged (Story 1.5 behavior) | silent |
| Tap a drawer nav item | drawer open | navigates to that route; back-arrow returns to `/` | N/A |
| Tap "Novo Chat" | drawer open | drawer closes, stays on `/` | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` -- add `SessionStatus? get currentStatus` and `void markAuthenticated()`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart:63-167` -- expose `_lastStatus` via `currentStatus`; `markAuthenticated()` calls `_emit(SessionStatus.authenticated)` directly (no network/storage — tokens are already persisted by `AuthRepositoryImpl` by this point).
- `lib/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart` -- new constructor dep `SessionRepository`; `submit()`'s success branch calls `markAuthenticated()` before emitting `ResourceData` (AD-1: presentation→domain, same feature — not a BLoC-to-BLoC reference, AD-7).
- `lib/features/auth/auth_injection.dart` -- wire `sl<SessionRepository>()` into `AuthCubit`'s registration.
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` -- new: the one `GoRouter`; a private `ChangeNotifier` wraps `statusStream` as `refreshListenable` (no `GoRouterRefreshStream` export in pinned go_router 18.1.1 — write a small local class); `redirect` reads `currentStatus` synchronously per the matrix above.
- `lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart` -- new: `MaterialApp.router`'s `builder:`; same one-shot guard/`ConfirmationDialog` call as `main.dart` today (spec-1-5), confirm now does `context.go('/reauth')`.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- new: header = generic `Avatar` (reuse, `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart`) + static label (no real identity — see Boundaries); "Novo Chat" + 3 nav items (`context.go(...)`).
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- new: `BootSplashScreen` (moved from `main.dart`'s `_BootLoadingScreen`), `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` (☰ opens `AppDrawer`, dark-green header), `BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen` (moved from `_BiometricReauthPlaceholder`), `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen`/`ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (shared back-arrow-header placeholder body), `ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen` (static kanban).
- `lib/main.dart` -- `_CerneAppState` keeps the boot `restoreSession()` call; `build()` returns `MaterialApp.router(routerConfig: ..., builder: ...)`; delete the moved classes/StreamBuilder logic.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add `colorScrimHeavy` (`0x66241F19`, `rgba(36,31,25,.4)` per `cerne-prototype.html`'s `OVERLAY: Drawer` block), `drawerWidth` (312 = 80% of the fixed 390 frame), kanban constants (column gap/min-width, card padding, spine width, dot size) per the same file's `Tela 5 — Planos de Ação` block.
- `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- portrait-only orientation keys (deferred-work.md item from Story 1.1).
- Ground truth: `docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`'s `<!-- OVERLAY: Drawer -->` and `<!-- Tela 5 — Planos de Ação -->` blocks; headers in the `Tela 1/4/6` blocks; `prototype-extract.md` §1-2.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` + impl -- `currentStatus`/`markAuthenticated()` -- sync redirect after login
- [x] `lib/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart` + `auth_injection.dart` -- call `markAuthenticated()` pre-success
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` -- GoRouter + redirect + refresh-listenable
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart` -- moved overlay wiring, now go_router-based
- [x] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- side menu, generic header
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- 5 screens (boot, home, reauth, meus-registros/configurações, planos-de-ação)
- [x] `lib/main.dart` -- switch to `MaterialApp.router`
- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- new tokens
- [x] `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- portrait lock
- [x] Test files listed in Verification -- redirect matrix, drawer, placeholders, updated `main_test.dart`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a fresh install, when the app launches, then all four destinations are reachable with zero broken links or crashes.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze`, when run after this change, then zero issues and no hardcoded `Color(0x`/`EdgeInsets.*` literal outside `design_tokens.dart`.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter test` -- all tests pass, including new/extended: `test/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl_test.dart`, `test/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit_test.dart`, `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` (new), `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new), `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart` (new), `test/main_test.dart` (rewritten), `test/core/design_tokens_test.dart`
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/core/navigation lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart lib/main.dart --include=*.dart` -- expected: no matches outside `design_tokens.dart`

type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-02'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Today `main.dart` hardcodes a single `MaterialApp(home: StreamBuilder(...))` with three throwaway screens — no real navigation exists, and none of the four base destinations (Home/Chat, side menu, Meus Registros, Configurações) or the extension-feature entry (Planos de Ação) do either.

**Approach:** Introduce the pinned `go_router` with one top-level `redirect` keyed off `SessionStatus` (AD-8), leaving the documented seam for RF03's `VaultStatus` (AD-14). Build the side-menu `Drawer` (the sole navigation hub) and five polished placeholder screens. Also lock portrait orientation (deferred from Story 1.1 — this is the first story with real app-shell UI).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exactly one `GoRouter`/`redirect`; it composes only `SessionStatus` for now — leave an explicit code-comment seam where RF03 plugs `VaultStatus` in first (AD-14), never a second competing `redirect`.
- Routes: `/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth` (Story 1.5's target), `/` (Home/Chat + drawer), `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`, `/configuracoes`. The three non-Home destinations' back-arrow always targets `/` (matches prototype's `goHome` on all three) — no drawer-within-drawer.
- Story 1.5's overlay boundaries are unchanged: expiry never navigates away, screen state is preserved, one-shot-per-episode, "Entrar novamente" still ends at the same throwaway placeholder (now at `/reauth`).
- New `SessionRepository.markAuthenticated()` is called by `AuthCubit.submit()`'s success branch *before* emitting success, so the router's redirect already sees `authenticated` by the time `onAuthenticated` navigates to `/` — without this, a fresh login would redirect straight back to `/auth` on the very first post-login navigation.
- Drawer header uses a generic (non-personalized) `Avatar` + static label — deferred-work.md records why real identity isn't wired up yet.
- Planos de Ação renders the prototype's static 3-column kanban with its exact hardcoded example cards — zero backend calls, zero drag/drop (AGENTS.md: extension features stay non-functional).
- Every new color/size literal goes in `design_tokens.dart` (RNF08): heavier drawer scrim `rgba(36,31,25,.4)`, drawer width, kanban spacing/sizing.
- Native Flutter `Drawer`/`Scaffold.drawer` for the side menu (not a hand-rolled overlay like `ConfirmationDialog`) — single low-stakes use, avoids a second bespoke overlay mechanism.
- Lock portrait-only orientation in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` (deferred-work.md, from Story 1.1) — no landscape path anywhere (epic UX constraint).

**Ask First:** if hitting correct synchronous `redirect` re-evaluation on each `statusStream` emission seems to need any package beyond the already-pinned `go_router` (e.g. a different state-management dependency), stop and ask before adding one.

**Never:**
- No `CONVERSAS`/past-chat-session list in the drawer and no real chat (RF04/RF07 not built) — only the static "Novo Chat" action (closes the drawer, no-op) and the three nav items.
- No vault/biometric logic added to the redirect (RF03/Epic 2's job) — leave the seam, don't hardcode a session-only assumption.
- No persisted/real user identity in the drawer (deferred-work.md), no editable profile name/avatar-upload (Epic 8).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Boot, status not yet known | app launch | `/boot` splash (unchanged >300ms-threshold spinner) | N/A |
| Boot, unauthenticated | no/dead stored session | redirected to `/auth` | silent |
| Boot, authenticated/expired | valid stored session | redirected to `/` | silent |
| Fresh login/signup success | `AuthCubit.submit()` resolves `right` | `markAuthenticated()` emits `authenticated`, then `/` | N/A |
| Mid-session expiry, any of the 5 routes | `AUTH_EXPIRED` | overlay over current route, route unchanged (Story 1.5 behavior) | silent |
| Tap a drawer nav item | drawer open | navigates to that route; back-arrow returns to `/` | N/A |
| Tap "Novo Chat" | drawer open | drawer closes, stays on `/` | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` -- add `SessionStatus? get currentStatus` and `void markAuthenticated()`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart:63-167` -- expose `_lastStatus` via `currentStatus`; `markAuthenticated()` calls `_emit(SessionStatus.authenticated)` directly (no network/storage — tokens are already persisted by `AuthRepositoryImpl` by this point).
- `lib/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart` -- new constructor dep `SessionRepository`; `submit()`'s success branch calls `markAuthenticated()` before emitting `ResourceData` (AD-1: presentation→domain, same feature — not a BLoC-to-BLoC reference, AD-7).
- `lib/features/auth/auth_injection.dart` -- wire `sl<SessionRepository>()` into `AuthCubit`'s registration.
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` -- new: the one `GoRouter`; a private `ChangeNotifier` wraps `statusStream` as `refreshListenable` (no `GoRouterRefreshStream` export in pinned go_router 18.1.1 — write a small local class); `redirect` reads `currentStatus` synchronously per the matrix above.
- `lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart` -- new: `MaterialApp.router`'s `builder:`; same one-shot guard/`ConfirmationDialog` call as `main.dart` today (spec-1-5), confirm now does `context.go('/reauth')`.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- new: header = generic `Avatar` (reuse, `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart`) + static label (no real identity — see Boundaries); "Novo Chat" + 3 nav items (`context.go(...)`).
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- new: `BootSplashScreen` (moved from `main.dart`'s `_BootLoadingScreen`), `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` (☰ opens `AppDrawer`, dark-green header), `BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen` (moved from `_BiometricReauthPlaceholder`), `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen`/`ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (shared back-arrow-header placeholder body), `ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen` (static kanban).
- `lib/main.dart` -- `_CerneAppState` keeps the boot `restoreSession()` call; `build()` returns `MaterialApp.router(routerConfig: ..., builder: ...)`; delete the moved classes/StreamBuilder logic.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add `colorScrimHeavy` (`0x66241F19`, `rgba(36,31,25,.4)` per `cerne-prototype.html`'s `OVERLAY: Drawer` block), `drawerWidth` (312 = 80% of the fixed 390 frame), kanban constants (column gap/min-width, card padding, spine width, dot size) per the same file's `Tela 5 — Planos de Ação` block.
- `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- portrait-only orientation keys (deferred-work.md item from Story 1.1).
- Ground truth: `docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`'s `<!-- OVERLAY: Drawer -->` and `<!-- Tela 5 — Planos de Ação -->` blocks; headers in the `Tela 1/4/6` blocks; `prototype-extract.md` §1-2.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` + impl -- `currentStatus`/`markAuthenticated()` -- sync redirect after login
- [x] `lib/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart` + `auth_injection.dart` -- call `markAuthenticated()` pre-success
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` -- GoRouter + redirect + refresh-listenable
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart` -- moved overlay wiring, now go_router-based
- [x] `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` -- side menu, generic header
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- 5 screens (boot, home, reauth, meus-registros/configurações, planos-de-ação)
- [x] `lib/main.dart` -- switch to `MaterialApp.router`
- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- new tokens
- [x] `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- portrait lock
- [x] Test files listed in Verification -- redirect matrix, drawer, placeholders, updated `main_test.dart`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a fresh install, when the app launches, then all four destinations are reachable with zero broken links or crashes.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze`, when run after this change, then zero issues and no hardcoded `Color(0x`/`EdgeInsets.*` literal outside `design_tokens.dart`.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter test` -- all tests pass, including new/extended: `test/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl_test.dart`, `test/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit_test.dart`, `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` (new), `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (new), `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart` (new), `test/main_test.dart` (rewritten), `test/core/design_tokens_test.dart`
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/core/navigation lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart lib/main.dart --include=*.dart` -- expected: no matches outside `design_tokens.dart`

198	+import 'dart:async';
199	+
200	+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
201	+import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
202	+
203	+import '../di/injection_container.dart';

206	+import '../../features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart';
207	+import '../../features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart';
208	+import 'placeholder_screens.dart';
209	+
210	+/// Every route this story's app shell resolves (Boundaries: "Routes:
211	+/// `/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth`, `/`, `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`,
212	+/// `/configuracoes`"). Named constants so no call site retypes a path
213	+/// literal that could drift from the one `GoRouter` below.
214	+abstract final class AppRoutePaths {
215	+  static const boot = '/boot';
216	+  static const auth = '/auth';
217	+  static const reauth = '/reauth';
218	+  static const home = '/';
219	+  static const meusRegistros = '/meus-registros';
220	+  static const planosDeAcao = '/planos-de-acao';
221	+  static const configuracoes = '/configuracoes';
222	+}
223	+
224	+/// The epic's ONE `GoRouter`/`redirect` (Boundaries: "never a second
225	+/// competing `redirect`") — composes only [SessionRepository.currentStatus]
226	+/// for now. [sessionRepository] is taken as a parameter (rather than this
227	+/// file reaching into `sl` itself) purely so a test can pass a fake/mock one
228	+/// directly, without touching the global DI container.
229	+GoRouter buildAppRouter({required SessionRepository sessionRepository}) {
230	+  return GoRouter(
231	+    initialLocation: AppRoutePaths.boot,
232	+    refreshListenable: _GoRouterRefreshStream(sessionRepository.statusStream),
233	+    redirect: (context, state) => _redirect(sessionRepository, state),
234	+    routes: [
235	+      GoRoute(
236	+        path: AppRoutePaths.boot,
237	+        builder: (context, state) => const BootSplashScreen(),
238	+      ),
239	+      GoRoute(
240	+        path: AppRoutePaths.auth,
241	+        builder: (context, state) => AuthScreen(
242	+          cubit: sl<AuthCubit>(),
243	+          onAuthenticated: (context) => context.go(AppRoutePaths.home),
244	+        ),
245	+      ),
246	+      GoRoute(
247	+        path: AppRoutePaths.reauth,
248	+        builder: (context, state) => const BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen(),
249	+      ),
250	+      GoRoute(
251	+        path: AppRoutePaths.home,
252	+        builder: (context, state) => const HomeChatPlaceholderScreen(),
253	+      ),
254	+      GoRoute(
255	+        path: AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros,
256	+        builder: (context, state) => const MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen(),
257	+      ),
258	+      GoRoute(
259	+        path: AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao,
260	+        builder: (context, state) => const ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen(),
261	+      ),
262	+      GoRoute(
263	+        path: AppRoutePaths.configuracoes,
264	+        builder: (context, state) => const ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen(),
265	+      ),
266	+    ],
267	+  );
268	+}
269	+
270	+/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:
271	+/// - status not yet known (`null`) -> `/boot`, unless already there.
272	+/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
273	+/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every
274	+///   other location (including `/reauth`, reached only by the expiry
275	+///   overlay's own explicit navigation) is left alone — a mid-session
276	+///   expiry never navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the
277	+///   three non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
278	+///
279	+/// AD-14 seam: Epic 2 (RF03) plugs a local `VaultStatus` gate in here,
280	+/// checked *before* this session check (Cross-Story Dependencies: "vault
281	+/// checked first") — e.g. `if (vaultStatus == VaultStatus.locked) return
282	+/// AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;` ahead of the block below. Nothing here should
283	+/// assume session validity alone ever decides access once that lands.
284	+String? _redirect(SessionRepository sessionRepository, GoRouterState state) {
285	+  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
286	+  final location = state.matchedLocation;
287	+
288	+  if (status == null) {
289	+    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
290	+  }
291	+
292	+  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
293	+    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
294	+  }
295	+
296	+  // status is authenticated or expired.
297	+  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot || location == AppRoutePaths.auth) {
298	+    return AppRoutePaths.home;
299	+  }
300	+  return null;
301	+}
302	+
303	+/// Wraps [stream] as a `Listenable` so `GoRouter`'s `refreshListenable` can
304	+/// re-run [_redirect] on every emission — go_router 18.1.1 exports no
305	+/// `GoRouterRefreshStream` of its own (Code Map), so this is that small
306	+/// local class.
307	+class _GoRouterRefreshStream extends ChangeNotifier {
308	+  _GoRouterRefreshStream(Stream<dynamic> stream) {
309	+    _subscription = stream.listen((_) => notifyListeners());
310	+  }
311	+
312	+  late final StreamSubscription<dynamic> _subscription;
313	+
314	+  @override
315	+  void dispose() {
316	+    _subscription.cancel();
317	+    super.dispose();
318	+  }
319	+}

346	+/// *above* the `Navigator`/`InheritedGoRouter` it wraps (per
347	+/// `WidgetsApp.builder`'s own doc), so this widget's own `BuildContext`
348	+/// has no `GoRouter` ancestor to look up.
349	+///
350	+/// Story 1.5's boundaries are unchanged here: the overlay traps focus
351	+/// until dismissed/actioned, is the only overlay allowed on screen at a
352	+/// time, never navigates away on its own, and fires at most once per
353	+/// `expired` episode.

355	+  const ExpiryOverlayHost({

368	+}

370	+class _ExpiryOverlayHostState extends State<ExpiryOverlayHost> {
371	+  StreamSubscription<SessionStatus>? _subscription;
372	+
373	+  // Same two one-shot guards `main.dart` used to own (code review of
374	+  // story-1-5): `_expiryOverlayShown` is a per-episode latch (nothing
375	+  // today transitions `SessionStatus` back out of `expired`, so without
376	+  // it a later event on this same subscription would reopen the overlay
377	+  // on top of wherever the user already navigated after confirming it);
378	+  // `_reauthRouteRequested` guards the dialog's own confirm callback
379	+  // against a rapid double-tap during its 180ms exit fade.
380	+  bool _expiryOverlayShown = false;
381	+  bool _reauthRouteRequested = false;
382	+
383	+  @override
384	+  void initState() {
385	+    super.initState();
386	+    _subscription = widget.sessionRepository.statusStream.listen(
387	+      _onStatus,
388	+      // Mirrors `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s own internal subscriptions — no
389	+      // current implementation ever errors on this stream, but a future
390	+      // one that did must not surface as an unhandled zone exception.
391	+      onError: (_, _) {},
392	+    );
393	+  }
394	+
395	+  @override
396	+  void dispose() {
397	+    unawaited(_subscription?.cancel());
398	+    super.dispose();
399	+  }
400	+
401	+  void _onStatus(SessionStatus status) {
402	+    if (status != SessionStatus.expired || _expiryOverlayShown) {
403	+      return;
404	+    }
405	+    _expiryOverlayShown = true;
406	+    // `showGeneralDialog` (inside `ConfirmationDialog.show`) pushes a
407	+    // route, which must never happen mid-build/mid-stream-callback —
408	+    // deferred to `addPostFrameCallback`, same as `main.dart` did.
409	+    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
410	+      if (!mounted) {
411	+        return;
412	+      }
413	+      // This widget's own `context` sits *above* the router's `Navigator`
414	+      // (see class doc) — `showGeneralDialog` needs a context *below* it,
415	+      // which `NavigatorState.overlay`'s own context always is.
416	+      final overlayContext = widget
417	+          .router
418	+          .routerDelegate
419	+          .navigatorKey
420	+          .currentState
421	+          ?.overlay
422	+          ?.context;
423	+      if (overlayContext == null) {
424	+        // Navigator not mounted yet — nothing to show an overlay over.
425	+        _expiryOverlayShown = false;
426	+        return;
427	+      }
428	+      unawaited(
429	+        ConfirmationDialog.show(
430	+          context: overlayContext,
431	+          builder: (dialogContext) => ConfirmationDialog(
432	+            icon: Icons.lock_outline,
433	+            title: 'Sessão expirada',
434	+            message:
435	+                'Sua sessão expirou por segurança. Entre novamente para '
436	+                'continuar — sua conversa continua aqui.',
437	+            caption: 'o histórico e a posição do scroll são preservados',
438	+            confirmLabel: 'Entrar novamente',
439	+            barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrim,
440	+            onConfirm: () {
441	+              if (_reauthRouteRequested) {
442	+                return;
443	+              }
444	+              _reauthRouteRequested = true;
445	+              if (dialogContext.mounted) {
446	+                Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop();
447	+              }
448	+              widget.router.go(AppRoutePaths.reauth);
449	+            },
450	+          ),
451	+        ),
452	+      );
453	+    });
454	+  }
455	+
456	+  @override
457	+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.child;
458	+}

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

input.message:
Review of your Story 1.6 implementation is done (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap layers, run in parallel against the diff). Five findings were classified as `patch` — trivially fixable, no spec/intent change needed. Apply all five, then re-run the spec's own Verification commands (`fvm flutter pub get`, `fvm flutter analyze`, `fvm flutter test`, and the RNF08 grep) and confirm they still pass.

1. **`lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart`** — `AppDrawer` wraps its content in `SafeArea` *and* applies `DesignTokens.drawerContentPadding`'s hardcoded top value of 59 on top of it, double-counting the status-bar clearance. Every other header in this story (`HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`, `_BackArrowHeader` in `placeholder_screens.dart`) uses the fixed-59 `navHeaderPadding` with no `SafeArea` at all — consistent with the epic's fixed 390×844 single-frame design (no responsive/dynamic-inset handling anywhere else in the app). Fix: remove the `SafeArea` wrapper from `AppDrawer`, so it relies on `drawerContentPadding`'s fixed top value alone, matching the other headers' convention.

2. **`lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` + `expiry_overlay_host.dart` + `lib/main.dart`** — `ExpiryOverlayHost` currently finds a `BuildContext` below the `Navigator` via `widget.router.routerDelegate.navigatorKey.currentState?.overlay?.context`, reaching into `GoRouter`'s internal `routerDelegate` — not a documented public API, so a future go_router upgrade could silently break it. `GoRouter` itself has no public `navigatorKey` getter (confirmed against the pinned 18.1.1 source), but it does accept an explicit `navigatorKey` constructor parameter. Fix: in `main.dart` (or inside `buildAppRouter`), create your own `final navigatorKey = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();`, pass it to `GoRouter(navigatorKey: navigatorKey, ...)`, and pass that *same* key into `ExpiryOverlayHost` as a new constructor parameter, using `navigatorKey.currentState?.overlay?.context` there instead of drilling through `routerDelegate`.

3. **Test coverage** — `ExpiryOverlayHost._onStatus`'s `overlayContext == null` branch ("Navigator not mounted yet") has no test. Add one — e.g. trigger the `expired` status before the router's `Navigator` is mounted/pumped, and assert no exception and `_expiryOverlayShown` resets to `false` (so a later mount can still show it). Bundle this with fix #2 since it touches the same code path.

4. **`lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart`** — `_GoRouterRefreshStream`'s `stream.listen((_) => notifyListeners())` has no `onError` guard, unlike its sibling listeners added in this same diff (`ExpiryOverlayHost`'s `statusStream.listen(_onStatus, onError: (_, _) {})` and `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s `_expirySubscription`). Fix: add `onError: (_, _) {}` for consistency — no current stream implementation errors, but a future one that did shouldn't surface as an unhandled zone exception here specifically.

5. **`test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart`** — the existing "☰ opens AppDrawer" test on `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` only asserts `find.text('Cerne')` and `find.byType(AppDrawer)`; nothing asserts `Scaffold.drawerScrimColor` actually equals `DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy` (only the token's raw RGBA value is tested elsewhere, never that it's wired to the `Scaffold`). Fix: extend that test to pull the `Scaffold` widget (`tester.widget<Scaffold>(find.byType(Scaffold).first)`) and assert `.drawerScrimColor == DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy`.

When done, report what changed and the verification output. Everything else from the review (a few accessibility/error-builder/test-coverage items) was triaged as pre-existing-scope "defer" and is being logged separately — not part of this patch round.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Today `main.dart` hardcodes a single `MaterialApp(home: StreamBuilder(...))` with three throwaway screens — no real navigation exists, and none of the four base destinations (Home/Chat, side menu, Meus Registros, Configurações) or the extension-feature entry (Planos de Ação) do either.

**Approach:** Introduce the pinned `go_router` with one top-level `redirect` keyed off `SessionStatus` (AD-8), leaving the documented seam for RF03's `VaultStatus` (AD-14). Build the side-menu `Drawer` (the sole navigation hub) and five polished placeholder screens. Also lock portrait orientation (deferred from Story 1.1 — this is the first story with real app-shell UI).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exactly one `GoRouter`/`redirect`; it composes only `SessionStatus` for now — leave an explicit code-comment seam where RF03 plugs `VaultStatus` in first (AD-14), never a second competing `redirect`.
- Routes: `/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth` (Story 1.5's target), `/` (Home/Chat + drawer), `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`, `/configuracoes`. The three non-Home destinations' back-arrow always targets `/` (matches prototype's `goHome` on all three) — no drawer-within-drawer.
- Story 1.5's overlay boundaries are unchanged: expiry never navigates away, screen state is preserved, one-shot-per-episode, "Entrar novamente" still ends at the same throwaway placeholder (now at `/reauth`).
- New `SessionRepository.markAuthenticated()` is called by `AuthCubit.submit()`'s success branch *before* emitting success, so the router's redirect already sees `authenticated` by the time `onAuthenticated` navigates to `/` — without this, a fresh login would redirect straight back to `/auth` on the very first post-login navigation.

| Boot, authenticated/expired | valid stored session | redirected to `/` | silent |

| Mid-session expiry, any of the 5 routes | `AUTH_EXPIRED` | overlay over current route, route unchanged (Story 1.5 behavior) | silent |
| Tap a drawer nav item | drawer open | navigates to that route; back-arrow returns to `/` | N/A |

feat(auth): story 1.4 — silent session refresh & persistence

Persists the refresh token alongside the access token, adds a SessionRepository
exposing the epic's singleton SessionStatus stream, and has main.dart branch its

## Summary — Story 1.6: Base Navigation Shell with Feature Placeholders

**Spec:** [_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-1-6-base-navigation-shell-with-feature-placeholders.md](_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-1-6-base-navigation-shell-with-feature-placeholders.md) — now `done`, with a Suggested Review Order appended (Ctrl/Cmd+click its links to jump to each stop). Sent to VS Code.

**What was built:** one `GoRouter` with a single `redirect` composing `SessionStatus` (AD-8), leaving the AD-14 comment seam for Epic 2's vault gate; a native `Drawer` side menu; five placeholder screens (Home/Chat, Meus Registros, Configurações, a static prototype-accurate 3-column kanban for Planos de Ação, plus the boot/reauth screens moved from `main.dart`); a `SessionRepository.markAuthenticated()` fix so a fresh login is reflected in the redirect immediately instead of bouncing back to `/auth`; and the portrait-orientation lock (picked up from a Story 1.1 deferred item).

**Review:** three parallel layers (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap) ran against the diff. 5 findings were `patch`-classified and applied + independently re-verified by me:
- [lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart](lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart) — removed a `SafeArea` that was double-counting against the fixed header padding
- [lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart](lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart) / [expiry_overlay_host.dart](lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart) / [main.dart](lib/main.dart) — replaced a reach into go_router's internal `routerDelegate` with an explicitly-owned `navigatorKey`
- new test for the overlay's "Navigator not mounted yet" branch
- added a missing `onError` guard on the router's refresh-stream listener
- added a test asserting the drawer's heavier scrim color is actually wired to the `Scaffold`

3 findings were logged as pre-existing/out-of-scope in `deferred-work.md` (no `errorBuilder` on the router, missing `Semantics`/touch-target sizing on nav icons, no regression test for drawer-only-on-Home). The rest were noise or already-settled decisions (e.g., the kanban's fidelity was a deliberate call already justified in the frozen spec).

**One thing worth flagging:** the implementer also made `passwordChanged` clear `emailError` (matching `emailChanged`'s existing symmetric behavior) — harmless and all tests pass, but it wasn't something this story's spec asked for. I didn't treat it as a defect, just noting it.

**Commit:** `c35f704` on `main`. Since Story 1.5 (expired-session overlay) was still uncommitted from before this session started, this one commit bundles both 1.5 and 1.6 — I called this out explicitly in the commit message rather than mislabeling it as 1.6-only.

**Verification (independently re-run, not just trusted):** `flutter analyze` → 0 issues; `flutter test` → 263/263 passing; RNF08 literal grep → clean.

Want me to push `main` and/or open a PR?

Você recebeu o argumento `<ID>`, onde `<ID>` é um de: `SETUP`, `PLAN`, `F000`, `RF01`…`RF10`.

**Se `<ID>` não foi fornecido, ou não é exatamente um desses valores: PARE. Não adivinhe, não infira pelo que estava sendo discutido na sessão. Pergunte ao usuário qual ID usar e espere a resposta antes de rodar qualquer coisa.** Gravar o ID errado corrompe a atribuição de tempo/tokens por unidade de trabalho (M1-M3) — é um erro sério, não um detalhe.
